categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Matches P2P area label and modifies compact block nonce generation in src/net_processing.cpp and test/functional/p2p_compactblocks.py.
categories.rationale: Fixes a privacy leak where reusing compact block nonces across network interfaces allows adversaries to correlate clearnet and privacy-network (e.g. Tor) connections to deanonymize nodes.
